rows.grounds: bahuvrihi compound hṛta-rājya; nominative singular masculine, sandhi before following voiced consonant
optative of bhū expressing possible consequence
compound para-rāṣṭra-samāgama indicating arrival or incursion of another realm

items.question: What loss of sovereignty and foreign incursion threaten the king under this omen?
premises: An inauspicious outer sign portends political calamity.
The king may become deprived of his kingdom.
A foreign kingdom may arrive or encroach.
items.inference: The omen foretells royal dispossession together with foreign incursion.
uncertainties: pararāṣṭrasamāgamaḥ may indicate hostile invasion or another form of foreign arrival.
items.plain_english: The king may be deprived of his kingdom, and a foreign kingdom may arrive.
